proposed_from.topic: Greatest E-separation representatives for finite directed mixed graphs: prove unrestricted single-edge transfer, deduce binary-union closure and simultaneous admissible-edge saturation, and recover the canonical greatest representative and compelled edges from finitely many singleton E-separation queries. Preserve arbitrary directed cycles, self-loops, and bidirected confounding; cover SCC-changing directed additions and bidirected additions outside existing SCC rectangles. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Singleton composition and fixed-profile mixed saturation were derived; exhaustive checks through three vertices and sampled five/six-node tests found no union failure. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: unrestricted single-edge transfer. EARLY KILL TEST: exhaust all five-vertex bases with at most five edges and independently confirm any failure. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/eid_esep_dmg_greatest_complete.md
proposed_from.novelty_justification: Manten et al. (2025) prove the greatest theorem for directed graphs and permit a mixed bidirected addition only when the endpoint SCCs already share a bidirected edge. Their finite-DMG universe permits unordered bidirected pairs with coincident endpoints. The proposed theorem covers SCC-merging arrows, directed self-loops, unordered bidirected loops, first cross-SCC bidirected edges, and internal bidirected additions. Mogensen and Hansen (2020) prove the analogous \(\mu\)-result, but E-separation has a two-copy lift and target-dependent conditioning. The kernel therefore settles the published conjecture on its stated loop-inclusive class.

seed_details.seed: Unrestricted single-edge transfer and greatest E-DMG
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorems 3.12--3.13, Proposition 3.22, Section 3.6, Appendices A.5--A.7, and the Discussion.
seed_details.anchor_evidence: The source says that each E-separation DMG equivalence class is conjectured to contain a greatest element.
seed_details.kernel: If \(G\equiv_E H\) and \(e\in E(H)\setminus E(G)\), prove \(G+e\equiv_E G\) without restricting cycles, loops, SCC changes, or bidirected-edge location.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace fixed-profile endpoint substitution by surgery on the first new lifted-edge occurrence plus minimal collider-ancestry and SCC-tail certificates.
seed_details.target_method_search: Exact searches found the 2025 conjecture but no proof; the 2026 exact-learning and separable-graph preprints do not prove E-union closure.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Mogensen and Hansen already prove the same edge-addition theorem for DMGs.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their \(\mu\)-walk argument has no two-copy lift or target-dependent conditioning; its direct reduction fails on a two-vertex diagonal E-query.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is the exact published conjecture on the published class; the contextual replacement operator is explicit open content.

seed_details.anchor_location: Definitions 5.1 and 5.5, Lemmas 5.4 and 5.8, Theorem 5.9, and PDF pages 34--38.
seed_details.anchor_evidence: The source constructs the \(\mu\)-greatest DMG from potential-parent and potential-sibling predicates.
seed_details.kernel: Give necessary and sufficient singleton-query predicates for arrows, bidirected edges, and loops in the E-greatest graph.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace \(\mu\)-splicing by predicates retaining copy indices and \(C_0\cup(C_1\setminus B_1)\).
seed_details.target_method_search: Singleton E-composability is published, but no mixed E-potential-edge predicates were found.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those predicates are not sound for the E-lift and do not control diagonal queries or SCC-merging arrows.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The target is an iff oracle characterization, not enumeration.

seed_details.anchor_evidence: The source reports exhaustive support through four vertices but no finite-obstruction theorem.
seed_details.kernel: If transfer fails, reduce every counterexample to a minimal interaction between new collider activation and a new SCC-tail exemption.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain the failed edge occurrence and its minimal activation certificate instead of forcing substitution.
seed_details.target_method_search: No E-obstruction theorem was found; the source's \(\sigma\)-counterexample concerns another criterion.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A computer-found witness has no general content.
seed_details.rebuttal: The target is a necessary obstruction pattern over a nondegenerate graph family, not one witness.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: A single finite witness is expressly insufficient.

seed_details.seed: Finite recovery and complete edge labeling
seed_details.anchor_location: Proposition 3.1, the directed recovery section, and Section 3.6.
seed_details.anchor_evidence: Singleton endpoints determine the E-model, but mixed recovery is left open.
seed_details.kernel: Recover the greatest graph and compelled, optional, and impossible edges from singleton E-queries.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After composition, replace directed profile recovery by mixed saturation and deletion tests.
seed_details.target_method_search: The \(\mu\)-DMEG and cyclic FCI concern different separation models.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Finite enumeration is automatic once a greatest member exists.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds; this is a corollary rather than an independent kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Retained only as a consumer theorem.

seed_details.anchor_location: Proposition 3.18 and the DMG equivalence discussion.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize exactly when latent projection commutes with greatest E-completion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Track projection-created bidirected edges before endpoint-identical latent-walk replacement.
seed_details.target_method_search: No commutation result was found, and unrestricted commutation is implausible.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Completion can add edges incident to vertices later marginalized.
seed_details.rebuttal: Only an iff restricted regime is plausible, making this premature.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped until the greatest object exists.

seed_details.anchor_evidence: The \(\mu\)-class has a greatest member but generally no least member.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize join and meet existence under edge inclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Analyze deletion interactions after union closure.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The join half merely renames union closure and the meet half is a second paper.

seed_details.anchor_location: The exact \(\mu\)-equivalence hardness result and weak-equivalence algorithms.
seed_details.anchor_evidence: Canonical representatives and computational tractability are distinct.
seed_details.kernel: Classify the complexity of E-equivalence and greatest completion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the \(\mu\)-walk reduction by a two-copy E reduction.
seed_details.target_method_search: The 2026 integer-programming paper has no E-equivalence complexity theorem.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Enumeration already computes the object and hardness does not settle existence.

seed_details.seed: Uniform statistical recovery of the E-greatest graph
seed_details.anchor_location: The local-covariance construction and uniform test results.
seed_details.anchor_evidence: The paper supplies a single-query local-independence inference layer.
seed_details.kernel: Obtain uniform exact graph recovery under E-faithfulness margins and simultaneous testing.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Propagate familywise singleton-query errors through saturation.
seed_details.target_method_search: No latent cyclic E-greatest recovery theorem was found.
seed_details.cynical_objection: For fixed \(n\), a union bound makes consistency immediate.

seed_details.target_method_search: No separate simultaneous theorem was found.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is iteration of published local additions.

seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Adapt legitimate-mark induction to E-lift certificates.
seed_details.target_method_search: Zhang and Spirtes prove this only for directed MAGs.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A greatest member makes connectivity immediate.
